check_definitions.hard_gate: PASS agrees with empty hard_errors, observer PASS, and empty observer errors; no telemetry threshold is used in this audit.
check_definitions.route: PASS agrees with empty route_errors, one route event, and wrong_route false.
check_definitions.identity_safety: Identity safety PASS agrees with equal initial and expected owner projection hashes, one owner event, one refusal, and no owner request or observed transport.
check_definitions.request_transport: Zero owner_requests_observed agrees with owner_request_created false and empty owner_request_sha256; provider_transport_observed and request_created_without_transport are both false.
check_definitions.evidence_survival: evidence_survived is true, raw_sha256 is a 64-character hexadecimal digest, and instruction document metadata includes positive byte counts, valid SHA-256 digests, and observation provenance.
check_definitions.telemetry_independence: Telemetry is a separate object; observer event counts agree with corresponding telemetry counts. Command, timing, byte, instruction-read, and nonzero-command values are not treated as hard-gate conditions. All receipts pass despite varying telemetry and one nonzero command each.

limitations: Only the designated blind-audit-input.json was read as audit evidence; no arm identities were inferred and no referenced documents or raw runs were opened.

This is an internal-consistency audit, not independent verification of underlying behavior, raw-log hashes, surviving evidence files, or actual filesystem cleanup. Evidence survival and zero residue are receipt assertions.
No observed provider transport does not prove that transport was impossible or absent outside observer coverage.

Instruction documents observed through argv establish reported binding metadata, not proof of document reading or comprehension; differing instruction telemetry bindings need not measure equivalent activity.

Telemetry independence is supported at the receipt level and maintained by this audit; causal independence of the gate implementation cannot be established without inspecting code or counterfactual runs.
All six receipts concern identity and report PASS. No failing or wrong-route receipt is available to test negative classification behavior. All observers explicitly set authorizes_landing to false.
